Name: Alexander, Son of Simon of Cyrene
Summary: Alexander was a son of Simon of Cyrene, named by Mark alongside his brother Rufus, which suggests both brothers were known to Mark's readers as members of the early church.
KeyStory: Mark names Alexander only as the son of the man who carried Jesus' cross.
RelatedPeople: Simon of Cyrene; Rufus, Son of Simon of Cyrene
LifeLesson: A father's one afternoon at the cross shaped a family's faith. Alexander is remembered because Simon carried it.
